title: Which work comes next is priority: the architect recommends it
situation: Record corrections, 2026-10-13: an independent architect read the design record cold and found settled decisions contradicting the current design, terms used but never defined, and concepts that disagree; the operator asked for the corrections to be applied. Decision 0102 no longer matches the current design.
decision: What comes next is priority, which the operator decides and the architect recommends: applying a priority the operator stated, the architect leads with one recommendation and its reasons, which is neither a hand-back nor an unrecorded decision. The hand-back and holding-open tells concern only meaning, the architect's one class of decision (0160).
consequences: The record now states this as the standing rule.
